settings.heading: I've tried probiotics. How is this different?
settings.content:
It's the question we hear most. Probiotics add more bacteria to your gut. That helps some people, but if unwanted bacteria are already hiding behind a protective layer, adding more on top doesn't reach them.

Veltia works on that layer instead. Garlic helps break it down,* so oregano, wormwood and black walnut can reach what's behind it.*

settings.heading: It worked for a while, then came back. Why would this be different?
settings.content:
You're not alone. Most people who find us have a story like that.

One common reason: bacteria tucked under a protective layer called biofilm can wait out a treatment, then grow back. Lab studies show garlic can help break that layer down,* which is why it leads our formula.

Veltia is a supplement, not medical care. If your symptoms are new, severe or getting worse, please see your doctor.

settings.heading: My main problem is urgency, running to the bathroom after I eat. Will this help?
settings.content:
That's one of the most common reasons people come to us.

When unwanted bacteria build up, they ferment your food fast. That can mean gas, cramping, bloating and that sudden need to go right after a meal. Veltia is designed to help clear that buildup, for calmer, more predictable digestion over time.*

If you see blood in your stool, are losing weight without trying, have a fever, or wake up at night to go, see your doctor first.

settings.heading: How long should I take it?
settings.content:
Plan on at least 90 days of daily use. The buildup didn't happen overnight, and it won't clear overnight either. It's also why our guarantee runs the full 90 days.

Want to keep going after that? Check in with your doctor first.

settings.heading: Is there a guarantee?
settings.content: Yes, a full 90 days. Take it daily, give it a real chance, and if you don't feel a difference, email us and we'll refund your order in full.

settings.heading: I've tried oregano oil before. Why would this work?
settings.content:
Oregano is good at what's out in the open. On its own, it has a hard time getting past the layer bacteria build around themselves.

So we didn't build Veltia around one herb. Garlic goes first to help open that layer up,* then oregano, wormwood and black walnut get to work on what's underneath.*

settings.question: Who should not take these drops?
settings.answer:
Talk to your doctor first if you:

  • are pregnant, nursing or trying to get pregnant
  • are under 18
  • take blood thinners or any prescription medicine
  • have seizures, or a liver, kidney or gallbladder condition
  • are allergic to ragweed or daisies (wormwood is in that plant family)

settings.question: How do I take it?
settings.answer:
Shake well.

Start with a few drops in a little water or juice, once a day.

Work up to one full dropper a day. Or follow the label.

settings.question: When should I see a doctor instead?
settings.answer:
See a doctor if your symptoms come with:

  • blood in your stool
  • weight loss you can't explain
  • fever, vomiting or bad pain
  • diarrhea that wakes you up at night
  • signs of dehydration, like dizziness or very dark urine

These drops are for everyday gut support.*
